# DynaLM

> DynaLM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) C++20 engine for running large language models locally on a CPU,
> with no GPU and no Python required. It is a local alternative to llama.cpp, Ollama and vLLM for CPU-only
> machines. It runs on Linux, macOS (including Apple Silicon) and Windows, and serves an OpenAI-compatible
> API.

Key facts:
- **Command-line tool:** `dynalm`.
  - `pull`: download a GGUF from Hugging Face.
  - `run`: generate from a prompt.
  - `chat`: interactive multi-turn chat, like `ollama run`.
  - `serve`: OpenAI-compatible server on port 8000.
  - `list`, `rm`, `inspect`, `benchmark`.
- **Model formats:** GGUF (as used by llama.cpp and Ollama), Hugging Face SafeTensors, GPTQ and AWQ.
- **Quantization:** Q2_K–Q8_0, F16, BF16. IQ types are not supported yet.
- **Model families:** Llama 1–3, Mistral, Qwen 2 / 2.5 / 3 (dense and MoE), Gemma 1–3, Phi-3, IBM Granite,
  Mixtral, DeepSeek-R1-Distill.
- **Not supported:** Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.8 (`qwen35`), LFM2, full DeepSeek-V3/R1.
- **Serving:** continuous batching, paged KV cache, chunked prefill, prefix (radix) cache, speculative
  decoding, Prometheus metrics.
- **CPU kernels:** AVX2 on x86-64, NEON on ARM64 and Apple Silicon.
- **Install:** `./scripts/install.sh` (Linux/macOS), `scripts\install.ps1` (Windows), or Docker.
